rule: A native child that lacks the retained component model of a plugin answers a retryable PLUGIN_UNAVAILABLE whose details name it as defined by the MissingModel and MissingModelDetails definitions of the component model schema (typed cause, plugin id, crate path, en + de summary). A launcher recognizes exactly that shape, in a tool error or a JSON-RPC error, and nothing else. The launcher compares the model manifest of the serving environment with the refreshed and with the on-demand rebuilt one: a different manifest marks the refresh changed (a swap is due) and makes an on-demand build report a changed model set.
